blockingIssues.message: The two-line headline hierarchy: At feed size, the photograph dominates more strongly and the headline loses the oversized, tightly packed emphasis that defines the approved composition. Fix: Increase both headline sizes and tighten tracking to recover their intended footprint while preserving the outline, RTL order, and separation from the photograph.
